name: 07701 · Red Bank, NJ
findings: ZIP 07701 (Red Bank) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07701 (Red Bank) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
